hero_images.description: An Indigenous Australian woman sits at a desk in an office setting, smiling and looking directly at the camera. A computer keyboard and telephone are on the desk in front of her, with a map visible on the wall behind.

A group of Indigenous adults and children are gathered outdoors under a large banyan tree, playing with a variety of toys spread on the grass. One adult in a pink shirt stands observing the activity, while other adults are seated with the children, engaged in play.
A person stands on a concrete dock, facing away from the camera, looking out at the vast blue ocean with distant green islands. They hold a bright yellow object aloft in their right hand.

An aerial view reveals a vibrant coastal community with numerous buildings, a long jetty, and a sandy beach, all set against the backdrop of a densely forested mountain. The town appears to be a mix of residential and public structures, including a large multi-purpose building and sports fields.

An aerial view of a coastal community, likely Palm Island, nestled between dense green hills and the ocean. The image features numerous houses, a large complex of public buildings possibly a school or community center with a sports field, a sandy beach, and calm water.

A tranquil tropical beach scene features a wide sandy shore meeting clear, calm ocean waters, with lush green, forested hills in the background under a cloudy sky. Dark tree branches frame the upper and lower left of the image, adding to the natural vista.

A smiling man with grey hair, wearing a light blue shirt and a green and black striped tie, stands indoors next to a glass panel featuring the green turtle logo and text for the 'Palm Island Community Company'.

A group of Indigenous women and children are gathered outdoors under large trees, enjoying a community playgroup or picnic. Several children play with toys on a blanket, while adults supervise and interact.
A group of Indigenous children sits on concrete bleachers inside a community building, attentively listening to an adult male instructor who stands and gestures.

A man stands on a concrete jetty, holding a yellow disc-like object high, looking out over the calm blue sea towards distant green islands under a clear sky. Concrete bollards mark the edge of the jetty.

A modern, single-story building with a light facade, dark roof, and dark windows/doors stands behind a well-maintained green lawn. Lush green foliage and a white chain-link fence line the foreground, under a bright, partly cloudy sky.
A wide shot of a coastal landscape features sandbanks exposed at low tide, calm shallow water, and a range of verdant hills on the horizon under a clear blue sky with some scattered clouds.

A vertical landscape photograph captures a serene coastal scene under a bright sky, featuring a distant forested hill, sparkling water reflecting sunlight, and a sandy foreshore with shallow tidal pools.
A dynamic shot of three boys engaging in water recreation: one is mid-air performing a tuck dive into clear blue water, another watches from a concrete pier, and a third swims in the background.
A headshot of an older Caucasian man with grey hair, wearing a dark suit and a green and blue striped tie, smiling directly at the camera against a plain light background.
A person viewed from behind stands on a concrete pier, holding a bright yellow object aloft towards a vast expanse of blue water. Distant green islands are visible on the horizon under a clear sky.

A vertical outdoor shot captures a serene coastal scene featuring a white concrete bollard on a weathered pier in the foreground. Beyond it, calm blue ocean waters extend to a distant green island under a clear, light blue sky.
A smiling woman with short, curly brown hair wears a red and white striped top, looking directly at the camera. She has a warm, inviting expression on her face.

Two young people are by the water, with one in mid-air jumping into the water from a concrete structure and the other standing on the structure watching. The jumper is shirtless and wearing dark shorts, making a 'rock on' hand gesture, while the other person wears a dark t-shirt and shorts.

A young boy in mid-air jumps from a concrete pier into water, making a peace sign with an excited expression. Another person with long hair leans on a metal railing in the background, observing the water.

A young Indigenous boy with curly hair smiles brightly and gives a thumbs-up gesture while looking directly at the camera. He is wearing an orange t-shirt, and in the background, a television is displaying a colorful animated scene.

Two young Indigenous men are training in an indoor boxing gym. The man in the foreground, wearing a single boxing glove, looks directly at the camera, while another man in the background practices with a speed bag. A heavy bag with "Jim Bradley Speedball" branding and a kangaroo logo is visible on the right.

A close-up portrait captures a young child with brown hair and dark eyes, smiling warmly while looking directly at the camera. The child is wearing a red shirt and appears to be holding a red crayon or pencil, with a blurred background suggesting an indoor setting.
A person with traditional white body paint and a colorful lei dances on sand, wearing a pink fringed skirt at an outdoor event.

Three individuals, likely women, are seated at a table indoors, engaged in an activity involving papers. The central figure, a young Indigenous woman with long curly hair, smiles brightly towards someone off-camera, while another person writes on paper.

A scenic view of a coastal area, featuring a blue and white ferry boat docked at a wooden pier. The foreground includes a sandy beach and green foliage, framed by dark tree branches, while lush green hills rise in the distance across the calm water.

An aerial view captures a vibrant tropical coastline featuring lush green forested hills and mountains sloping down to pristine sandy beaches. The clear blue ocean transitions to lighter turquoise shades over shallow areas, potentially revealing coral reefs, with a small coastal settlement visible in the distance along the bay.

A headshot-style portrait features an older man with grey hair, smiling gently at the camera. He is dressed in a dark pinstripe suit, a light blue collared shirt, and a green and dark blue striped tie.

A smiling older man in a light blue shirt and white pants leans against a blue pillar on a wooden deck, with a light blue building visible behind him and construction materials on the ground to the left.
A smiling older woman with curly brown hair is featured in a professional portrait, wearing a black blazer over a patterned blouse.

A vibrant outdoor scene features a calm body of water reflecting numerous light-trunked trees, likely eucalyptus or paperbark, that line its banks. The foreground shows several tree trunks with exposed roots at the water's edge, and fallen leaves dot the water's surface.

A decorated pier with balloons and palm fronds extends into the blue ocean, featuring a sign overhead that reads "Great Palm Island". A boat is docked alongside the pier, and a few people are visible on the structure, with a rocky shoreline in the foreground.

A man in a red shirt and patterned shorts stands proudly next to a white pickup truck, branded with the "Palm Island Community Company" logo, against a scenic backdrop of blue ocean and distant islands.

Two smiling men are seen riding a single horse along a dirt path next to a paved road, enjoying a sunny day outdoors. The background features lush trees and a clear sky, suggesting a tropical or subtropical environment.

Two young Indigenous women participate in an outdoor event, with one speaking into a microphone while holding notes, and the other standing behind her. They both wear green and yellow polo shirts, and other individuals are partially visible in the sunny background.

An older Indigenous woman and a young Indigenous girl, both smiling warmly, are pictured embracing against a light-colored outdoor wall. The woman wears a pink top, and the girl wears a light blue tank top and an orange bracelet.

Four smiling Indigenous women are featured in the foreground of an outdoor community gathering. One woman stands behind two seated women, while a fourth woman is seated at a table, all appearing happy and engaged in the event.
Two Indigenous women and five children are sitting on a blue tarp outdoors, surrounded by colorful toys. The adults and some children are smiling, creating a warm, community-focused scene.

An aerial view of a tropical coastline featuring a pristine sandy beach curving along a dense green forest. The clear turquoise water reveals shallow coral formations transitioning to a deeper blue ocean, with a few buildings visible within the trees.

A serene landscape view of a calm body of water reflecting the sky and the surrounding environment, bordered by dense pine trees on the far bank. Bare tree branches extend into the water from a grassy bank in the foreground.

Two smiling Indigenous Australian women are seated indoors, looking towards the camera. The younger woman on the left wears a blue top, and the older woman on the right wears a patterned white and purple blouse, with informational posters visible on the walls in the background.

A smiling Indigenous man with curly hair and a beard is seated at a wooden table, wearing a light blue collared shirt with an embroidered logo on the pocket. He is looking directly at the camera with a friendly expression.

A panoramic outdoor shot showcasing a lush, green landscape with hills, trees, and a prominent bare tree in the foreground, overlooking a coastal town, a serene blue ocean, and multiple islands in the distance under a partly cloudy sky.

An Indigenous woman with short, curly brown hair smiles warmly while holding a dark mug in a brightly lit kitchen. A white electric kettle and a colorful bouquet of artificial flowers are on the counter beside her.

Three women, including two Indigenous Australian women and one Caucasian woman, are smiling warmly at the camera in an indoor setting. They appear to be staff or community members, likely from the Palm Island Community Company.
A tranquil landscape featuring a body of water with a green-blue hue, surrounded by lush foliage and trees in the foreground, and rocky, tree-lined banks in the distance under a bright sky.
A diverse group of seven adults, including men and women, smiling and posing for a photo outdoors in a lush tropical setting with palm trees and a white structure in the background.

An aerial view of a coastal town nestled between a vast forested mountain range and the clear blue ocean. The town features residential buildings, a main road along the coast, a jetty with boats, and stretches of sandy beach.

A young Indigenous girl with a top knot hairstyle crouches on a wooden deck, smiling at the camera while playing with a wooden toy service station. She is wearing a striped top, denim shorts, and pink thongs.

Four men, including two Indigenous men, stand smiling outdoors on a new rubber-mulch playground. They appear to be community leaders or partners at a project site, with a blue and white building visible in the background.
An aerial view captures a coastal town nestled against a densely forested mountain, featuring numerous houses, a sandy beach, a pier with boats, and vibrant blue ocean waters.
An Indigenous woman with dark reddish-brown hair smiles gently, wearing a vibrant blue patterned top, against a plain, light background. She is captured in a professional portrait.
A smiling Indigenous woman in an orange collared shirt and lanyard stands on a wooden deck, leaning on a railing. She is outdoors in front of a light blue building with windows and doors.

Three young children are playing in a brightly lit indoor space, possibly a daycare or classroom, featuring a round wooden table with chairs, a small bed, and colorful educational materials and toys on a green floor mat.

An Indigenous Australian woman with dark skin and hair tied back is in a kitchen, looking towards the camera with a slight smile while reaching into a large plastic container filled with chopped fruit. She is wearing a purple shirt, and a white refrigerator and kitchen cabinets are visible in the background.

A young Aboriginal girl with dark hair tied back is engrossed in an art activity at a table, holding a small green object in one hand and red tongs in the other, with baskets of colorful craft materials nearby. In the blurry background, a banner partially reads "DEADLY KIDS".

A young Indigenous child with dark skin and hair in a top bun sits on a grey playground slide outdoors, wearing a light purple long-sleeve top and white pants, giving a cheerful thumbs-up gesture towards the camera.
Indigenous children, adorned with white body paint, participate in an outdoor cultural dance or ceremony on a grassy field, with adults in traditional attire visible in the background.

An Indigenous woman with long dark hair and a bright smile sits at an office desk, wearing a green and black polo shirt. She is looking to her right, and the office cubicle behind her features various posters and documents.
An adult Indigenous woman and a young Indigenous child are engaged in playing with colorful wooden peg puzzles at a table in a bright classroom or childcare setting.

Four Indigenous Australian men are gathered outdoors in a natural, bushy setting. An older man with a beard and a cap sits on the left, next to a younger man with a mustache and sunglasses on his head, wearing a black and orange polo shirt with a "Palm Island" logo. Another younger man stands behind them, and an older man with grey hair stands on the right.

A close-up shot of several vibrant cushions adorned with Indigenous Australian artwork, showcasing various dot paintings and animal motifs in warm, earthy tones and bright greens, resting on a floor inside an orange-hued space.

A close-up shot of several handcrafted, elongated pod-like objects, some painted with vibrant colors such as red, pink, green, and purple, hanging by strings. In the background, abstract artworks with strokes of green, yellow, and red paint on brown paper are visible.

A diverse group of eight people, including men and women, walk along a sandy beach on a sunny day. They appear to be engaged in conversation, with a lush, green, hilly landscape and calm bay in the background.
A close-up shot of a light-colored surface, possibly fabric, covered with numerous colorful handprints in various sizes and hues, including red, orange, yellow, green, blue, black, and white.

A group portrait of five smiling Indigenous people, including three adult women and two young girls, sitting together indoors. One woman is wearing a black and orange polo shirt with the "Palm Island Community Company" logo.

Three young Indigenous women sit on blue posts at the edge of a pier, looking out over a vast, calm blue ocean towards distant islands. The scene captures a moment of quiet contemplation by the water under a clear, bright sky.

A scenic view of a sandy beach featuring a protective rock wall (revetment) lining the coast. Palm trees and lush green hills stretch along the shoreline, meeting the calm blue ocean under a partly cloudy sky.
A headshot portrait of an older Caucasian man with gray hair, smiling directly at the camera. He is wearing a dark suit, a white shirt, and a green and blue striped tie.

A headshot portrait of an older woman with short, dark curly hair, wearing a patterned black, red, and white top. She is looking directly at the camera with a gentle smile against a soft, blurred indoor background.

A man wearing glasses and a striped shirt sits at a desk in a medical office or clinic, looking directly at the camera. The desk is cluttered with medical equipment, an anatomical torso model, papers, and a computer monitor.
Three Indigenous women smile brightly behind a display counter in the Palm Island Community Shop, with a large sign for the shop and various merchandise like jewelry visible in the foreground.

Two smiling Indigenous girls in yellow and green school uniforms are sitting on a blue bench outdoors, eating yogurt from small containers. They appear to be in a schoolyard or community setting with colorful structures in the blurred background.

A smiling Caucasian man in a red polo shirt with a white collar and white trim on the sleeves, featuring a green turtle logo, stands against a blurred background with colorful shapes. He has a short beard and is wearing a dark watch on his left wrist.

An Indigenous Australian woman with a warm smile is seated behind a reception desk, looking directly at the camera. The desk has a 'RECEPTION' sign in red letters and various documents on top, while office shelving and decor are visible in the background.

Three women are engaged in a medical procedure in a clinical setting. An Indigenous woman, wearing a red polo shirt, is having her blood drawn from her arm by a healthcare professional, while another woman, wearing a plaid top, observes and interacts with her.

A young child with curly hair and a pink top intently plays with playdough and a small wooden rolling pin at a table, with another child's hand visible on the right reaching into a container of pink playdough.

An elevated view of a tranquil coastal scene on a sunny day, featuring clear blue-green shallow water transitioning to a sandy beach. Along the shore, there's a concrete esplanade, palm trees, a prominent white building, and other structures, all backed by a large green, tree-covered mountain under a partly cloudy blue sky.
A smiling man with dark hair, wearing a black suit and a green and black striped tie, is posing for a headshot against a plain white background.
A headshot of an Indigenous Australian woman with dark hair pulled back, wearing glasses, and a purple and white patterned top, smiling gently against a plain grey background.

A headshot portrait of an older Indigenous Australian man, possibly a community elder or leader, wearing a dark suit, a light blue collared shirt, and a green and blue striped tie, looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile.
A smiling woman with dark skin and braided hair looks directly at the camera, wearing a white shirt and a bright pink cardigan. The background is brightly lit and out of focus.
A headshot of a smiling man of color with short dark hair, wearing a dark pinstriped suit jacket, a light blue collared shirt, and a green and blue striped tie, against a plain light grey background.
A close-up headshot of a smiling man with a bald head and a white goatee, wearing a dark suit jacket over a blue collared shirt and a green and black striped tie.

A light blue building housing the Palm Island Children and Family Centre is seen with a branded white van parked in front. Stairs lead up to the building's entrance, which features a decorative dark gate.
A serene, light blue landscape featuring a vast body of water with sunlight reflecting off its surface, distant landforms, and a sky with scattered clouds.
An aerial view of a vibrant green tropical landscape with a calm body of water, possibly a bay or river, nestled between lush, tree-covered hills. The image is rendered in a monochromatic orange hue.

An aerial view captures the vibrant tropical landscape of an island, featuring a lush green forest-covered hill, a curving sandy beach, and crystal-clear turquoise ocean waters revealing extensive coral reefs beneath the surface.

A man of Indigenous appearance, wearing a green sports jersey and a light green cap, sits outdoors and smiles at the camera while holding two pieces of light-colored, curved wood, possibly in preparation for carving. Trees and some background clutter are visible.

A scenic view of a wooden pier or jetty extending into calm, clear blue-green water under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. A sandy beach with gentle waves and a rocky shoreline occupies the right and foreground, while distant hills or islands are visible across the bay.

Four Indigenous women and girls, likely from Palm Island, pose for a photograph, smiling. The background suggests an outdoor market or festival setting, and one woman's shirt promotes the 'Palm Island Spring Festival - September 2014'.

A high-angle view overlooks a tropical coastal town featuring houses nestled among lush green trees, a prominent tree with reddish-orange leaves, and the calm blue ocean stretching to distant hills. The foreground is framed by leafy branches.

A monochromatic orange-toned landscape photo depicts a wide beach at low tide, with wet sand, rocks, and sunlight glinting off the calm ocean. A tree-covered hill forms the right coastline, while distant mountains are visible across the water under a lightly clouded sky.

Three young children are seated at a table, drawing on paper with markers. The child in the center is laughing with their mouth wide open, wearing a striped shirt with Elmo, while the other two children in blue and orange shirts smile and look at their drawings.

Three smiling Indigenous women are seated at a table indoors, looking towards the camera. Papers and booklets are visible on the table, and a large, vibrant yellow and brown artwork hangs on the wall behind them.

An older Indigenous man in a blue patterned polo shirt and black cap leans on a white van featuring the green turtle logo and "Palm Island COMMUNITY COMPANY" branding. He looks directly at the camera, with natural light suggesting an outdoor setting.

A wide panoramic view captures a serene coastal scene with calm blue waters leading to distant mountainous islands under a bright blue sky dotted with white clouds. On the right, a wooden pier extends into the water from a sandy beach, bordered by a rocky embankment.

Five Indigenous women, three in the foreground smiling at the camera, are pictured indoors. The central woman wears a grey t-shirt with "MADE TO LOOK" text, while the woman on the right wears a vibrant blue and orange shirt with "SPRING FESTIVAL" and fruit imagery. Two other women are visible in the blurred background.
A smiling woman with dark, curly hair and sunglasses on her head is seated at a desk indoors, wearing a green and black polo shirt featuring the 'Palm Island Community Company' logo.

Three Indigenous Australian children, a young girl and two boys, pose outdoors in front of a building. The girl and the boy in the middle are smiling and making peace signs, while the boy on the right has a more serious expression and makes a similar hand gesture. The image has an orange overlay.

A man in a light blue polo shirt stands smiling next to a reception desk, while a woman with glasses and a patterned blue shirt sits behind the desk, also smiling at the camera. The setting appears to be an office or community center reception area.
A low-angle shot of a lush palm tree, displaying its green fronds and some coconuts, set against a vibrant blue sky with scattered white clouds.
A serene landscape photo featuring a vast expanse of light blue water with sparkling sunlight reflections, distant mountains, and a light blue sky with scattered clouds.

A group of Indigenous Australian women and children, including several babies and toddlers, are smiling while leaning on a metal railing on a wooden deck. They appear to be multi-generational families in an outdoor setting, with a light blue building in the background.

Three young children, wearing hats and school-like uniforms, stand side-by-side on a colorful outdoor playground structure and smile directly at the camera. The child in the center wears a Batman shirt, and the playground features orange, purple, and blue bars.

A smiling Indigenous woman, wearing a red apron over a grey and orange shirt, holds a tray of freshly baked goods (likely pies) near an open industrial oven in a commercial bakery setting. The oven is made of stainless steel with glass viewing panels and number labels '3' and '5'.
A man in a blue shirt, appearing to be a mechanic, smiles while leaning over the open hood of a car, surrounded by tools and equipment in an indoor garage setting.
Two Indigenous men proudly hold a large red fish on a jetty, with one man smiling at the camera. The background shows open water and distant land, suggesting a coastal or island setting.

Three smiling men, two wearing yellow polo shirts and one in a grey polo shirt and a cap, stand outdoors. The man in the center gives a thumbs-up, and the man on the left has "Palm Island Community" written on his shirt.

Two Indigenous women are seated at an outdoor table, engaged in conversation. One woman, in a wheelchair, has her back to the camera, while the other smiles and gestures with her hands while speaking.

Three children, appearing to be of Indigenous descent, sit smiling on a blue carpet in what looks like a classroom. A sign with the word "COLOURS" and color swatches is visible on the wall in the background.

An Indigenous woman, possibly a healthcare worker, is examining the ear of an Indigenous boy with an otoscope. The boy is seated and looks attentive, while the woman kneels beside him, focusing on the examination in an indoor medical or clinic setting with office shelves and an eye chart visible in the background.

Four young Indigenous children, wearing blue bucket hats, are sitting on a red bench outdoors, smiling happily at the camera. Two children on the left wear purple t-shirts, while the two on the right wear a white and a light pink t-shirt respectively.

A joyful Indigenous man, wearing a blue shirt with an Aboriginal flag patch and an orange cap, gently holds a beaming Indigenous baby who wears a light blue bib. Both are smiling warmly, set against a bright, possibly outdoor, background.

A composite image featuring an Indigenous man holding a baby, and an older Indigenous girl, all in black and white, against a light blue background adorned with vibrant purple, yellow, pink, and dark blue paint brush strokes.

A smiling older woman, likely Indigenous, is pictured in a close-up portrait, seated in front of an abstract blue and white background. She is wearing a patterned top and appears to be sitting at a table.

An aerial view captures a vibrant tropical coastline with deep blue waters transitioning to clear turquoise over shallow reefs, a sandy beach, and a densely forested headland in the foreground. In the distance, a small coastal settlement is nestled against rolling green hills under a hazy sky.
A smiling Indigenous Australian woman with glasses and her hair tied up holds a happy baby, both looking directly at the camera. They are outdoors with a blurred green background.

A smiling Indigenous Australian woman with dark, curly hair holds a happy baby wearing a white fluffy jumpsuit. They are looking directly at the camera in a bright, possibly outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
A young Indigenous boy, wearing a school-like uniform, smiles brightly as he intently writes or draws with a pencil on paper in an outdoor setting.
A smiling Indigenous Australian woman wearing a patterned shirt and a lanyard sits next to a child, both partially visible in an outdoor setting, likely engaging in a community activity.

An Indigenous woman, wearing a Palm Island branded shirt, sits on the floor with five young Indigenous children, reading an animal picture book to them. They are in an indoor setting, possibly a classroom or childcare center, with toy kitchen furniture visible in the background.

Indigenous Australian artwork featuring a golden snake with traditional dot painting patterns, coiling amidst black leaves and a pink flower. The background is a speckled purple with white and gold splashes.

An abstract painting featuring a vibrant purple background with white and gold splatters, large black heart-shaped leaves with white outlines and red accents, and a central golden curved band adorned with black, white, and red dot patterns and yellow star-like elements, characteristic of Indigenous Australian art.
A smiling woman, likely a staff member, wears a black head covering and a polo shirt with the 'Palm Island Community Company' logo, captured indoors.

A family of four, consisting of two adults and two children, smiles warmly while posing outdoors against a backdrop of lush palm trees. The man is squatting, while the woman stands behind him with an arm around one of the children.
A smiling young Indigenous girl with curly brown hair sits barefoot on a large rock by the ocean, wearing a dark blue t-shirt and white patterned shorts.

A serene tropical beach scene features several leaning palm trees framing a sandy path that runs alongside a calm ocean bay. The water reveals low tide flats, with distant green hills and islands visible under a bright blue sky dotted with white clouds.

Two Indigenous girls, one older and one younger, are engaged in a painting activity at an outdoor table. The younger girl in a pink dress actively paints a sculptured object, while the older girl in a teal polo shirt with Indigenous art designs watches and assists.
Five Indigenous children sit barefoot on colorful stools on sandy ground covered with leaves, holding white cups and looking towards the camera, with a beach and ocean in the background.

A group of thirteen Indigenous children and young people are gathered on rocks at a sandy beach, posing for a photo. They are smiling and looking at the camera, with a calm ocean and distant mountainous islands under a blue sky with white clouds in the background.

Seven Indigenous men are standing side-by-side on a sandy path, facing the viewer, with a bright blue sky and a coastal beach scene in the background. They are casually dressed and appear to be part of a community group.
A smiling Indigenous man in a yellow and blue work shirt leans on a wooden railing outdoors, with a blurred background of green foliage.

Two Indigenous Australian women and two young girls smile and pose for the camera on a porch or veranda. One of the women holds a binder with the title "Ready Together" and a Queensland government logo.

Eight Indigenous children are gathered outdoors on a patterned mat, eating snacks from plates and looking at books. They are sitting on the ground under dappled sunlight, with rocks, grass, and a paved area visible in the background.

A healthcare worker, possibly Indigenous, leans in to examine the ear of a young child with an otoscope, while the child is held by an adult. The child looks directly at the viewer with a finger in their mouth.

A close-up portrait of an older Indigenous Australian woman with dark, curly hair, looking directly at the camera with a thoughtful and serious expression. Two other Indigenous women are visible, blurred in the background, suggesting a community setting.

Two men, seen from behind, stand amidst dense bushland, appearing to observe their surroundings. One man wears a wide-brimmed hat, while the other wears a cap and a shirt with "Palm Island Community Company" visible on the back. The photo is in black and white.

A young Indigenous girl with face paint on her cheek smiles warmly at the camera. She is wearing a bright orange and yellow shirt with "Gathering" written on it, set against a blurred outdoor background of people and greenery.
A young boy and an adult man are standing on a pier, engaged in fishing. The boy looks out to the left while the man holds a fishing rod, looking towards the water.

Two young Indigenous girls smile directly at the camera, with other children blurred in the background. The girl on the left has white flower face paint and a purple t-shirt, while the girl on the right wears a light blue tank top with 'Constable Clancy Says Police are your friends' badges.
Five Indigenous women are sitting side-by-side on an outdoor bench, smiling at the camera. The background features a beach and water, with a palm tree trunk visible on the right.

A black and white, close-up portrait of a smiling young Indigenous boy wearing a polo shirt with text on the collar. He is looking slightly to the side, with a blurred background suggesting an indoor setting and other people.

A group of seven Indigenous men sit outdoors on a concrete ledge by the water, with a pier visible in the background. Several men are clapping or have their hands clasped, and many are wearing vibrant shirts featuring Aboriginal art designs.
Two smiling young Indigenous girls, one with face paint, are captured in a close-up outdoors, likely at a community event.
A young Indigenous girl wearing a sun hat with antennae and a Moana t-shirt sits on a wooden bench, holding a bowl of food and smiling gently at the camera.

A diverse group of people gathers on a grassy field by the ocean at sunset, with tall palm trees and event tents in the background. Several individuals are facing away from the camera, including a 'Liaison Officer' and 'Police' officer.
A smiling Indigenous woman in a blue patterned polo shirt is in sharp focus, looking directly at the camera. Another smiling woman, also wearing a blue patterned shirt, is blurred in the background.

Two young boys, shirtless and in swim shorts, stand on what appears to be a dock or pier. The boy on the left is focused on a small object in his hands, while the boy on the right, seen from behind, holds a fishing rod, suggesting they are preparing for fishing.

An Indigenous woman and a young girl are prominently featured holding a banner that reads "Domestic Violence It's With Us!" with a red handprint symbol during an outdoor community event. Several other people are visible in the background, also participating.

A black and white photograph shows three men, likely Indigenous Australians, in an indoor setting. The man in the foreground, with a beard, holds a paintbrush and looks directly at the camera while appearing to paint on a surface. Two other men are blurred in the background, also looking towards the camera.

An older Indigenous man and a younger Indigenous woman are engaged in a shopping interaction inside a community thrift store. The man holds up a green jacket on a hanger while the woman looks at it, holding a small item in her hand.
Three children are silhouetted against a vibrant sunset sky on a beach, with two wading in the shallow water near the horizon and one running along the shore in the foreground.

A smiling Indigenous woman with glasses rests her hand on the shoulder of a smiling Indigenous man, both looking directly at the camera. The woman is wearing a yellow and teal polo shirt with 'Palm Island Community Company' logo.
A young Indigenous man with short curly hair, a brow piercing, and an earring smiles warmly at the camera, with blurry figures visible in the background, suggesting a community gathering.
A smiling older woman with short, reddish-brown hair and a patterned black and white top with an orange neckline is pictured from the chest up, leaning on a dark surface.

A picturesque tropical beach scene features a bright blue sky with white clouds, a calm turquoise ocean, and distant islands on the horizon. A large palm tree frames the right side of the image, while four people walk along the white sandy beach.
A smiling older woman with short, light brown hair looks directly at the camera, wearing a vibrant patterned top against a plain gray background.

A young person with curly hair and a green and yellow polo shirt smiles broadly, looking towards an older person whose back is partially visible in the foreground, suggesting a friendly outdoor conversation.

An Indigenous man and boy sit on wooden steps in front of a light blue building, both looking at the camera and smiling. The man has his arm around the boy's shoulder, and the boy is wearing a green and yellow polo shirt.
An older Indigenous woman with reddish-brown hair is in the foreground, looking directly at the camera with a faint smile, while three other people are blurred in the background.

Two Indigenous women are engaged in a conversation indoors. One woman, seen from behind, wears a vibrant shirt featuring the Aboriginal flag symbol on its sleeve. The other woman, who is older, smiles warmly while gesturing with her hands.

A close-up portrait of an Indigenous Australian woman wearing a teal polo shirt with the "Palm Island Community Company" logo. Two other Indigenous women are blurred in the background, one in yellow and one in blue.

An Indigenous Australian woman, wearing an orange and blue polo shirt with an Indigenous dot-art pattern, smiles at the camera while steaming milk at a coffee machine in an indoor cafe or community kitchen.

Three Indigenous women are pictured indoors, with one on the left partially visible from the back, wearing a shirt adorned with an Aboriginal flag. The other two women stand behind a red counter, facing each other and engaged in a conversation.

A close-up portrait of an older Indigenous man with a serious expression, wearing a yellow t-shirt that says 'STAY GOLD'. He is looking directly at the camera, with vibrant Indigenous artwork visible in the soft-focused background.
A man in a dark bucket hat with 'ECO PRO' and 'RAYERS' logos on it looks thoughtfully to his left, resting his chin on his hand. Another blurred figure is visible in the background.
Two smiling Indigenous women, wearing 'Palm Island Community Company' shirts, stand outdoors with one's arm around the other, against a blurred background of a building and greenery.
